channel.title: Nithin Jambula
channel.description: Software engineer: robotics and AI systems

item.title: Context-Preserving RAG system for enterprise documents
item.description: Source-backed answers from PDF, DOCX and text files. Combines vector and BM25 keyword search, routes each question to the best search strategy, and records which passages every answer used.

item.title: Paper at IEEE AIRC 2026: neuro-symbolic API security testing
item.description: A Neuro-Symbolic AI Framework for Adaptive and Explainable API Security Testing. 7th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Robotics, and Control. DOI 10.1109/AIRC69745.2026.11631384.

item.title: AprilTag docking rover (ROS 2)
item.description: A ROS 2 rover that finds and docks with its station on its own using AprilTag pose estimation and a multi-stage mission state machine.

item.title: Software Engineer, Robotics & Autonomy at Ananta Technologies
item.description: Behavior trees, AprilTag-guided robot positioning, a 50+ scenario MuJoCo/Webots test suite (35% faster validation) and 2 robots taken from simulation to production.

item.title: Paper at IEEE iSAI-NLP 2025: deepfake and counterfeit currency detection
item.description: Securing Reality: AI-Driven Detection of Deepfakes and Counterfeit Currency. 20th iSAI-NLP. DOI 10.1109/ISAI-NLP66160.2025.11320726.

item.title: PatchPilot: multi-agent code review with LangGraph
item.description: AI agents review GitHub pull requests for security, quality and logic. A LangGraph state graph routes each pull request, and ChromaDB memory lets reviews learn from past issues.

item.title: 16fps: multi-agent video generation, commercial rights sold
item.description: A multi-agent system that generates consistent videos over a minute long from text, using memory, tool use and self-review. Commercial rights and access sold to a media production company.

item.title: EchoSight named awardee at Vikas 2024; patent filed
item.description: Navigation glasses for the visually impaired running YOLOv8 at 45+ FPS on a Raspberry Pi, with spoken directions.

item.title: Student research engineer at AIR Centre, VIT-AP
item.description: LLM agents with rule-based reasoning for API security testing (+34% vulnerabilities found, 70% less manual testing), and a real-time AI voice calling agent.

item.title: Vulcan self-driving EV: perception & navigation lead
item.description: DeepLabV3+ segmentation, lane following, CARLA + SAC + DAgger, real-time on NVIDIA Jetson.
